reviews.text: She's been looking after my Elvis (an 80-pound Goldendoodle) for 4 years now, and he's always gorgeous when I pick him up!! She calls him her big baby ;)
Great experience with Jenny and team. Maui always looks adorable.
My dog Toby loves going there. Everything is always perfect.
We were very happy with our first visit for our Cocker Spaniel. Cocker Spaniel haircuts are always a bit tricky, but this one was done very well on our dog. Thank you, and see you next time.

Worst pace to bringg your dog.   They are nice when you are there but when you leave they are rough with the dogs to the point of traumatizing them.

There’s better and cheaper options out there.  Do your research.  Don’t bring your pet to someone who just sees them as a dollar sign.  Find someone that cares about them and their well-being
My dog Stella is a super fearful drama queen (haha and a pit bull ridgeback mix) and the groomer here cut her nails without a fuss in just a few minutes. Love the house cats!!
Finally, a grooming salon in VMR! I brought my cat in for a claw trim and a quick trim. I'm very satisfied. It all took 10 minutes. The staff were very gentle.
Wonderful groomer. They do such a great job. Returning customer. Thank you for making my babies so beautiful!

Best place ever, I have a Boston/Bull and it
came out looking better than ever
The staff were attentive, and the work was magnificent. My dog ​​didn't want to go outside anymore! That had never happened when we lived in Quebec City. I highly recommend this salon.
Excellent service, competent worker, nothing to say, everything is perfect, I will be back!
Great job considering my dog hates grooming. Staff super friendly and love the little shop feel. It was my first time but it won’t be last. Thank you very much!

Great grooming experience handled my dogs with care and had no issues.

Thank You❤️!
Grooming job is just OK. My dog was traumatized after the session and was crying to leave. Bad payment experience: 15% tip was already entered on the terminal by the merchant. Won't go back.

If I could give 0 star, I would.
It was the worst grooming experience, instead of taking the time to detangle the knotted fur behind the ears, they shaved the knotted area, which is terrible for double coated dogs. And the cut is uneven, the edges weren’t smooth, we showed them a photo of the look we are looking for, they said they can do it, but the results were completely the opposite of what we wanted.
Luna, Mirka, and Panda always come back looking beautiful and clean. Excellent service :)
